diagnosis: The handler deletes an ongoing migration wizard session solely by migration_session_id without verifying that session.owner_id == current_user.id. Any authenticated user can abort and delete another user's in-progress data import wizard session.
exploit_request:
DELETE /api/v1/wizards/migrations/mig_sess_41280 HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
corrected_code:
@router.delete("/api/v1/wizards/migrations/{migration_session_id}")
async def reset_migration_wizard(
    migration_session_id: str,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_db),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    stmt = select(MigrationSession).where(
        MigrationSession.id == migration_session_id,
        MigrationSession.owner_id == current_user.id
    )
    res = await db.execute(stmt)
    session = res.scalar_one_or_none()
    if not session:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Migration wizard session not found")
    await db.delete(session)
    await db.commit()
    return {"status": "reset", "session_id": migration_session_id}
